name: tailscale-mcp
post_parameters: sh -c export TAILSCALE_API_KEY=$(cat /run/secrets/key); exec supergateway --stdio tailscale-mcp-server --port 8097
description: Tailscale MCP server, bridged over HTTP with supergateway (baked into the image) so any MCP client that speaks HTTP/SSE can use it. Lets an MCP client inspect and manage your tailnet - devices, ACLs, routes.

paths.name: tailscale-api-key
paths.description: Read-only bind mount to a file containing your Tailscale API key (never put the key directly in a Variable).

ports.name: Host Port 8097
ports.description: HTTP port supergateway serves the bridged MCP endpoint on.

variables.name: TAILSCALE_TAILNET
variables.description: Your tailnet name, e.g. your-org.ts.net or an email for a personal tailnet.
